scenarios.name: Game Board Initialization
scenarios.description: Verify that the game board displays correctly with clearly defined boundaries when the game loads

steps.description: Navigate to the game HTML page in a web browser
Check that the rectangular game board is rendered with visible boundaries
steps.context: Game board should be centered and clearly visible

steps.description: Confirm the game shows a 'Ready' state with start prompt
steps.context: Should display 'Press any key to start' or similar prompt

test_cases.expected: Canvas element is created with defined width and height
Game board has clearly visible rectangular boundaries
Game loads and becomes interactive within 2 seconds

scenarios.name: Snake Initialization and Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the snake is correctly initialized and displayed as connected segments

steps.description: Press any key or click start button to begin the game
Check that snake appears as connected segments with distinctive color
steps.context: Snake should have initial length (typically 3-5 segments)

steps.description: Confirm snake starts at a valid position on the game board
steps.context: Snake should not start overlapping boundaries

test_cases.expected: Snake is created with correct initial length and position
Snake segments are displayed as connected body parts
Snake has a valid initial direction (not stationary)

scenarios.name: Arrow Key Controls
scenarios.description: Verify that the snake responds correctly to arrow key inputs for directional control

steps.description: Begin a new game with snake in motion
Press the Up arrow key
steps.context: Snake should not currently be moving down

steps.description: Confirm snake changes direction to up
Repeat for Down, Left, Right arrow keys

scenarios.name: WASD Alternative Controls
scenarios.description: Verify that WASD keys work as alternative controls for snake movement

steps.description: Begin a new game with snake in motion
Press the W key for up direction
steps.context: Snake should not currently be moving down

steps.description: Test A (left), S (down), D (right) keys
steps.context: Each key should map to corresponding direction

scenarios.name: Prevent Reverse Direction
scenarios.description: Verify that the snake cannot reverse directly into itself (180-degree turn)

steps.action: Start game with snake moving right
steps.description: Begin game with snake moving in right direction
Attempt to reverse direction by pressing opposite direction
Confirm snake continues moving right, ignoring invalid input

scenarios.name: Food Generation and Display
scenarios.description: Verify that food items appear at random positions on the game board

steps.description: Begin a new game
Check that a food item is displayed on the board
Confirm food is placed at a valid grid position not occupied by snake
steps.context: Food should not overlap with snake body

test_cases.expected: Food position is within game board boundaries

test_cases.input: Generate food when snake occupies positions
test_cases.expected: Food does not spawn on snake body
Food is visually distinct with contrasting color
Food positions are randomized (not always same location)

scenarios.name: Snake Growth on Food Consumption
scenarios.description: Verify that the snake grows by one segment when consuming food

steps.description: Control snake to move towards the food item
steps.context: Game is in progress, food is visible

steps.description: Move snake head to food position
steps.context: Snake head coordinates match food coordinates

steps.description: Confirm snake length increased by exactly one segment
steps.context: Snake should grow from the tail

steps.description: Check that a new food item appears after consumption
steps.context: New food should be at different random location

test_cases.expected: New food item spawns at random location
Snake grows correctly after each consumption

scenarios.name: Score Tracking and Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the current score is displayed and updates in real-time when food is consumed

steps.description: Begin a new game
Check that score is prominently displayed
steps.context: Score UI element should be visible

steps.description: Navigate snake to eat food
steps.context: Score should update upon food consumption

steps.description: Confirm score increased after eating food
steps.context: Score display should reflect new value immediately

test_cases.expected: Score is prominently visible on screen
Score updates immediately upon food consumption

scenarios.name: Wall Collision Detection
scenarios.description: Verify that the game ends when the snake collides with wall boundaries

steps.description: Control snake to move directly towards a wall boundary
Allow snake head to reach wall boundary
steps.context: Snake head coordinates exceed game board limits

steps.description: Confirm game transitions to 'Game Over' state
steps.context: Game should stop and display game over screen

test_cases.input: Snake moves along wall without collision

scenarios.name: Self Collision Detection
scenarios.description: Verify that the game ends when the snake collides with its own body

steps.description: Consume food until snake is long enough to self-collide
steps.context: Snake must have at least 4 segments

steps.description: Make a series of turns that cause head to hit body
steps.context: Create a loop pattern with the snake

steps.description: Confirm game ends when head touches any body segment

test_cases.input: Snake head position equals any body segment position
Snake head adjacent to body (no collision)

test_cases.expected: Collision detected accurately regardless of snake length

scenarios.name: Game Over Screen Display
scenarios.description: Verify that a Game Over screen displays with final score when the game ends

steps.description: Cause the snake to collide with wall or itself
Check that game over screen/overlay is displayed
steps.context: Screen should clearly indicate game has ended

steps.description: Confirm the final score is shown on game over screen
steps.context: Score should match the last in-game score

test_cases.input: Check final score on game over
test_cases.expected: Final score matches last playing score
Screen includes 'Game Over' text and score

scenarios.name: Game Restart Mechanism
scenarios.description: Verify that the game can be restarted after game over

steps.description: Play until game ends
Click restart button or press designated key
Confirm all game state is reset to initial values
steps.context: Snake, score, and food should be reinitialized

test_cases.input: Press restart key/button after game over

test_cases.expected: Snake resets to initial length and position

scenarios.name: Progressive Speed Increase
scenarios.description: Verify that snake movement speed increases as the score increases

steps.description: Begin game and note initial snake speed
Consume multiple food items to increase score
steps.context: Score should pass speed increase threshold

steps.description: Confirm snake moves faster than initial speed
steps.context: Game should remain playable at increased speed

test_cases.expected: Game remains playable (speed has reasonable cap)

scenarios.name: High Score Persistence
scenarios.description: Verify that the highest score is persisted and displayed across browser sessions

steps.description: Play the game and achieve a specific score
steps.context: This becomes the high score if highest

steps.description: Let the game end naturally
steps.context: Score should be saved if it's a high score

steps.description: Reload the page or open in new session
Check that previous high score is shown
steps.context: High score should be loaded from storage

test_cases.expected: Stored high score is retrieved correctly

test_cases.input: New score lower than high score
New score higher than high score
test_cases.expected: High score is updated to new value

test_cases.input: Page refresh after setting high score
test_cases.expected: High score persists and displays correctly

scenarios.name: Pause and Resume Functionality
scenarios.description: Verify that the game can be paused and resumed

steps.description: Begin a new game with snake in motion
Press pause key (e.g., Space or P)
Confirm snake stops moving and game is paused
Press pause key again to resume

test_cases.expected: Game pauses and snake stops moving
Paused state is visually indicated to user

steps.context: Feedback should be noticeable but not disruptive
